title: Redwood Vail Press
body:
## The publishing imprint of Edmond A Porter

**Redwood Vail Press** is the small independent imprint under which author Edmond A Porter publishes his work. It is not a commercial press accepting outside submissions. It exists to give Edmond's books a consistent publishing identity, a clear point of contact, and the editorial and production standards he wants attached to his name.

The imprint is based in Utah and operates as a single-author press at launch.

## What the imprint publishes

Redwood Vail Press focuses on writing rooted in the American West — historical fiction grounded in real events and real geography, rural memoir, and short-form essays and poetry drawn from a working life on the land.

The editorial sensibility favors:

- **Place over plot device.** Settings researched closely enough that locals recognize the ground.
- **Restraint over spectacle.** Quiet stakes, slow burns, human-scale consequences.
- **History treated as ground, not backdrop.** When real events appear, the facts are honored before the story bends them.

## Catalog

### *[Turbulent Waters](/books/turbulent-waters)* — Forthcoming, June 1, 2026

A historical fiction romance set against the 1976 [Teton Dam collapse](/teton-dam-flood) in eastern Idaho. Jake Ford works as an assistant engineer on the dam; Anna Stone fights its construction to protect the Yellowstone Cutthroat trout downstream. The river brings them together. The flood tears their worlds apart.

Release day is June 1, 2026 — four days before the 50th anniversary of the breach. Available for Kindle pre-order now; signed print copies will be sold in person at the *Flood 50* commemoration in Rexburg, Idaho. See the [Teton Dam Flood](/teton-dam-flood) page for event details.

*Turbulent Waters* is the imprint's launch title.

## More from Edmond A Porter

Not every book of Edmond's appears under the Redwood Vail Press imprint. For the complete bibliography — including independently published essay and poetry collections and contributions to anthologies — see [Published Works](/publications).

## Contact

For media inquiries, review copies, event bookings, or trade questions related to Redwood Vail Press titles, please use the [contact form on the main site](/#contact) and mention *Redwood Vail Press* in your message.

The imprint is not currently open to outside submissions.
